tasks.title: Conversation #91
tasks.transcript:
Man: I forgot to pack my lunch today. Any recommendations for a good place nearby?
Woman: There's a new cafe around the corner from the office that has great sandwiches and salads.
Man: Sounds perfect. Do they have vegetarian options?
Woman: Yes, plenty. They also have a daily special, which is usually vegetarian.
Man: Great. I'll head there during my lunch break.

questions.stem: Why is the man asking about a place to eat?

options.A: He is celebrating a special occasion.
options.B: He forgot to bring his lunch to work.
options.C: He wants to try a new type of food.
options.D: He wants to meet a friend for lunch.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士为什么要询问吃饭的地方？ 定位原文：Man: I forgot to pack my lunch today. Any recommendations for a good place nearby? 选项分析： A. He is celebrating a special occasion. 他在庆祝某个特别的日子。对话中未提及庆祝活动，所以A选项错误。 B. He forgot to bring his lunch to work. 他忘记带午餐去上班了。男士明确说自己忘了打包午餐，所以B选项正确。 C. He wants to try a new type of food. 他想尝试一种新食物。男士只是因为没带午饭才需要找地方吃饭，并非特意想尝试新食物，所以C选项错误。 D. He wants to meet a friend for lunch. 他想和一个朋友吃午饭。对话中未提及和朋友见面，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the man?

options.A: He does not have a lot of time to eat.
options.C: He does not eat certain foods.
options.D: He usually exercises during the lunch break.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：关于男士可以推断出什么？ 定位原文：Man: Sounds perfect. Do they have vegetarian options? 选项分析： A. He does not have a lot of time to eat. 他吃饭时间不多。对话中未提及时间紧张，所以A选项错误。 B. He is on vacation. 他在度假。对话中提到的“office”“lunch break”说明他在工作，所以B选项错误。 C. He does not eat certain foods. 他不吃某些食物。男士特意询问是否有素食选项（vegetarian options），可以推断他可能不吃肉或某些特定食物，所以C选项正确。 D. He usually exercises during the lunch break. 他通常在午休时锻炼。对话中未提及锻炼，所以D选项错误。
